samples.player_text: What would make the rest of the day go well?
history: player
Hi Craftsman. What do you usually work on first thing in the morning?
npc
It's good to see you. Usually, I check the tools. A dull blade or loose handle can ruin a whole day. Then, whatever’s been drying overnight, I’ll look at that next. It’s a quiet start, mostly.
player
What part of that work matters most to you?
npc
The quiet, I suppose. It lets me see what needs doing. And it lets me remember what I’m trying to make. It's easy to forget, sometimes.
player
Does anything make the work difficult today?
npc
The humidity is high. Wood doesn't behave well when it's damp. It's a small thing, though. I’ll just need to be a little more careful.
samples.candidate_dialogue: It would be good to finish the drying rack. It’s been taking longer than I hoped. A clear afternoon would help, of course. But mostly, just a steady hand and a little focus.
